Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses a substrate-trapping strategy with affinity purification (TAP-TAG and GST pull-downs) to identify prolyl hydroxylation substrates. While PRIDE metadata lists 'Top-down proteomics', the methods explicitly describe trypsin digestion ('digestion by trypsin'), indicating a bottom-up approach. The primary PTM of interest is proline hydroxylation (MOD:00425).

cell_types: triple negative breast cancer (TNBC) cell line MDA-MB-231
cell_lines: 293T cells were transfected with either HA-tagged ADSL or empty vector
scope: Our screening combines the optimized substrate-trapping strategy with a TAP-TAG purification followed by mass spectrometry.
combining this enzyme-substrate-trapping strategy to GST-EglN2 pull-down followed by mass spectrometry.
The EglN2 immunoprecipitates from MDA231 cells were eluted in 8 M Urea... followed by digestion by trypsin.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis focused on identifying substrates of EglN2 using affinity-based capture (TAP-TAG and GST pull-down) rather than whole cell lysates.
